title: marrubium deserti
intro: Marrubium deserti, commonly known as Desert Horehound, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its hairy stems and leaves with a distinctive fragrance. The health benefits of Desert Horehound include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive problems, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Desert Horehound include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
